Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ أَدْخِلْ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْقُبُورِ السُّرُورَ
Translation: O Allah, bring happiness to the people of the graves
O Allah, enrich every poor person
O Allah, satisfy every hungry person
O Allah, clothe every naked person
O Allah, settle the debt of every indebted person
O Allah, relieve every distressed person
O Allah, return every stranger (to their home)

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ كُلَّ فَاسِدٍ مِنْ أُمُورِ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ
Translation: O Allah, rectify every corrupt affair of the Muslims
O Allah, heal every sick person
O Allah, fulfill our poverty with Your richness

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ غَيِّرْ سُوءَ حَالِنَا بِحُسْنِ حَالِكَ
Translation: O Allah, change our bad condition with Your good condition

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
Translation: O Allah, settle our debts and free us from poverty
Indeed, You have power over all things
